title: Probing the 'Toxic Persona' Feature as a Cheap EM Early-Warning Signal

original_idea.body: Whether persona-projection rises before behavioral EM during fine-tuning (early warning).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: an activation early-warning that fires before behavioral EM is a deployable monitoring primitive.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: difference-in-means, public data/models, monitoring primitive for non-lab actors.

novelty.reasoning: Persona direction controls EM; early-warning-timing angle may be open.
